name: the-leak
description: The Leak — subscription tracker on Cloudflare (Pages + Workers + D1 + R2 + Clerk)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@leak/web & npm run dev --workspace=@leak/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@leak/shared && npm run build --workspace=@leak/web && npm run build --workspace=@leak/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@leak/shared && npm run build --workspace=@leak/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@leak/shared && npm run build --workspace=@leak/api
